sentence: Past phase 1 the line-up of divisions changed shape somewhat, its centre of weight moved about 25 km south, and divisions kept their places in line.
Past phase 2 the line-up of divisions kept the same shape, its centre of weight stayed put, and divisions kept their places in line.
Past phase 3 the line-up of divisions changed shape somewhat, its centre of weight moved about 56 km south, and divisions kept their places in line.
Past phase 4 the line-up of divisions took a different shape, its centre of weight moved about 54 km south, and divisions mostly kept their places; 16 fewer divisions got past it.
